component.name: Mountie
component.summary: GUI to Mount and manage network shares

description.p: Mountie keeps your network shares in one place and mounts them with a single toggle. It handles SMB/CIFS, AFP, NFS, SFTP, FTP and WebDAV through GVfs. No administrator rights are needed and nothing has to be added to fstab.

ul.li: Add, edit and remove shares for any host and protocol GVfs supports
Mount and unmount with one click, with status shown for each share
Passwords are stored in the system keyring, never on disk in plain text
Each mounted share gets a short, stable path such as ~/Shares/Photos, instead of the long generated GVfs location
Light and dark themes, following the desktop's own preference and accent color by default

description.p: Mountie works on any desktop that provides GVfs and a secret service, including COSMIC, GNOME and KDE Plasma.

screenshot.caption: Every configured share with its connection status and local path
Adding a share takes a protocol, host, path and optional credentials
The interface follows your desktop's light or dark preference

description.p: Improved reliability and a more maintainable application structure.

ul.li: Distinguish authentication, missing-share and network connection errors
Support passwordless and anonymous network shares
Keep mount state accurate when operations fail
Safely edit and delete mounted shares after unmounting
Validate and encode network addresses, paths and IPv6 hosts
Report configuration and keyring failures without terminating
Mount and unmount SMB/CIFS, AFP, NFS, SFTP, FTP and WebDAV shares
Credentials stored in the system keyring
Short, stable local paths for mounted shares
